aggregation.band: mean plus/minus one sample standard deviation; not a confidence interval
aggregation.diagnostic_time_sampling: One logged PPO update every 25 iterations; not an average of 25 updates. Iteration zero is behavior cloning and has no PPO diagnostic values.
aggregation.seed_weighting: equal weight for each of five independent training seeds
aggregation.validation: Between-seed sample variance of each checkpoint's overall validation mean; not scenario variance, held-out uncertainty or critic explained variance.
aggregation.within_update: Except episode_reward, diagnostics are minibatch-size-weighted averages over all minibatches of all four PPO epochs in the logged update.

diagnostic_definitions.approx_kl: Diagnostic mean of ratio - 1 - log(ratio), using stored rollout log probabilities.
diagnostic_definitions.entropy: Entropy in nats of the masked categorical policy.
diagnostic_definitions.episode_reward: Pre-update rollout mean of 24-hour reward sums over 256 episodes.
diagnostic_definitions.policy_loss: Minimized negative clipped policy surrogate; normalized advantages.
diagnostic_definitions.value_loss: Half mean squared critic error, before the extra 0.5 loss coefficient.

explained_variance_figure: not produced; no critic explained variance is inferred
